line: **Rule (Rung execution and stopping)** · `rule:compiler:fence-refinement` The following Work-limited stopping and accounting rules describe the current version-one implementation, not the replacement replay contract of (`[ROOT-resol:design:replay-paper-contract]`). They remain held under realizes{``[ROOT-open:design:cross-build-replay]``; This names the version-one implementation and its replacement hold without claiming portable Work.} Preparation validates domains and constructs the expected question under the declared operation's finite limits; it is distinct from numerical attempt Work. Each rung then runs the entire declared absolute-width precision sequence in order until its comparison separates, its cumulative maximum_work cannot fund a next charged operation, or an operational stop occurs. maximum_work sums actual numerical request Work, including request-scope construction, across precision steps of that rung; each request also retains its own operation and permanent store ceilings. Smaller per-request resource ceilings are operational stops, not evidence that the cumulative allowance was spent. A request starts a fresh store and retains its own original query, precision, checked attachment and actual ledger. The published starting-precision field cannot skip the sequence. A straddle after the last declared precision is INDECISIVE with PrecisionSequenceExhausted; a straddle retained before a real Work exhaustion is INDECISIVE with WorkLimit, including an exhaustion during construction of the next request. No Work is padded. Failed and INDECISIVE rungs are passed over; the descending driver stops at the greatest proved pass and retains all earlier independent attempts (``alg:epoch:tilt-backoff``). An interruption, no-bound exhaustion or other operational stop has no selected rung. A partial Search is not a complete standing certificate. The accepted solve uses its separate maximum_solve_work allowance; exhausting it publishes nothing at the selected rung and never reopens rung selection. Replay uses the separate declared maximum_replay_work allowance because independent checking and production retain separate charged ledgers, even though both share only exact repeats within their declared evaluation; replay exhaustion publishes no checked standing. This version-one implementation follows network-v0.32.0, ``def:epoch:tilt-backoff-grid`` and ``rem:epoch:certificate-failure-versus-indecisive-enclosure`` on its declaring build and fresh-request discipline; it does not establish cross-build reproduction or independence from arbitrary reuse history.
reason: The implemented rung route was reviewed against this release; its zero-row contract is not relabelled.

line: **Amendment (Retained finalization time)** · `amend:acts:retained-finalization-time` The admitted historical reader uses Full and FullEmpty lists and recomputed earlier public causal parents and dependency times, carrying endpoint frontiers across epochs. Missing and non-earlier predecessors do not enter the maximum. RecomputedTime::Available is an exact u128; the finite in-memory sequence bounds the result independently of published stamps. Mismatch retains a published stamp differing from the recomputed value as local stamp-fault evidence; it never repairs that stamp. A Tombstoned list produces RecomputedTime::Unavailable naming its act; unavailable inputs propagate their complete missing-opening set through incidence and predecessor maxima. UnavailableOpening establishes neither a stamp fault nor compliance. Independent acts with all inputs available still receive numeric times. Unavailable means not established by this replay, not unestablishable from retained data. This conservative replay does not compute interval bounds, dominance proofs or out-of-interval stamp faults: even a tombstoned first act and a successor whose available frontier dominates the concealed predecessor remain unavailable. Interval reasoning is a separate evidence enhancement; authenticated reopening remains the recipe obligation. Neither limitation bounds recognition or title. (`claim:acts:parent-replay-separates-placement-from-stamping`), (`claim:acts:epoch-qualified-placement-retains-causal-checks`), (`claim:acts:attached-times-match-scoped-incidence-replay`) and (`claim:acts:time-evidence-never-rewrites-finalization`) witness this scope. Authenticated openings and retained commitment carriage remain under (`[ROOT-open:design:dependency-opening-recipe]`); no codec or digest is introduced. This is the retained local recurrence, not the current paper’s public-only courtesy fold. The public-only optional time at network-v0.37.4 is unbuilt and not claimed under (`[ROOT-open:design:noncompliant-logical-time]`); no admitted placement, stamp or golden value changes. The retained reader was admitted against network-v0.37.0-draft.1; this historical implementation fact does not retag its recurrence as the current courtesy rule. The act-and-epoch document concept (`[ROOT-spec:actepoch:concept]`) decides the designed and unbuilt successor for the document subjects stated here; this statement retains its landed or admitted rule until its owner admits the successor document cut, and current fixtures witness only their existing scope.
reason: The retained private-input time reader keeps its admitted implementation provenance; the changed public-only courtesy reader is unbuilt.
